claims.quote: new development to bring estimated £151 million boost to region
claims.statement: The new GBR headquarters development is estimated to bring a £151 million boost to the region's economy.

claims.quote: Construction of the brand-new development in at Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.
claims.statement: Construction of the Becketwell headquarters is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.

claims.quote: Up to 600 apprentices between 16 and 21 years old will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship
claims.statement: Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next four years on the rail foundation apprenticeship.

claims.quote: The new HQ will bring hundreds of rail jobs to the city
claims.statement: The new headquarters will bring hundreds of rail jobs to Derby.

claims.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
claims.statement: The Becketwell site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff.

claims.quote: the first starters based in Derby helping to cement the city’s role as Europe’s largest rail hub
claims.statement: The first foundation apprenticeship starters based in Derby will help cement the city's role as Europe's largest rail hub.

claims.quote: less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25
claims.statement: Less than 7% of the railway's workforce is under 25.

claims.quote: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby, a city that has railways in its DNA.
claims.statement: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby, which Burnham describes as a city that has railways in its DNA.

claims.quote: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission - better services for passengers
claims.statement: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission of better services for passengers.

claims.made_by: Work and Pensions Secretary Pat McFadden
claims.quote: This foundation apprenticeship will give young people the chance to explore career paths within the sector at an exciting time
claims.statement: The foundation apprenticeship will give young people the chance to explore career paths within the rail sector.

claims.made_by: Mayor of the East Midlands Claire Ward
claims.quote: I’m delighted that Great British Railways will be based here, bringing hundreds of jobs into the city.
claims.statement: Great British Railways being based in Derby will bring hundreds of jobs into the city.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of the Great British Railways headquarters was unveiled in Derby on 15 October 2026.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
facts.statement: Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years.

facts.quote: 76,000 extra seats a week introduced across the network
facts.statement: 76,000 extra seats a week have been introduced across the network.

facts.quote: the recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north set to be built at Alstom’s Derby site
facts.statement: There has been a recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north to be built at Alstom's Derby site.
